propositions: Automated filers and human/agent sources lack a standard way to record which detection channel (canary, CI, review-bot, etc.) identified a bug, preventing escape-channel trend measurement.

Environment variable REBAR_DETECTED_BY (env default) and optional --detected-by flag (explicit override) must stamp detected_by at the create_core seam so all ingress paths (CLI, library, MCP) capture the source with zero friction.
The detected_by value is normalized via strip+lowercase; empty/whitespace-only is treated as unset; unknown tokens are preserved verbatim (no enum enforcement); creation never fails on the value.
The process_create reducer projects detected_by present-only into compiled state; events without the field reduce byte-identically to pre-change behavior (additive property).
The detected_by field is declared as optional in ticket_state.schema.json and registered in the env-var/docs registry.
